webSearch.title: Gushakisha kuri Web
webSearch.description: Bigenzura ukuntu gushakisha kwa webi bibandanya igihe Search Mode ikoreshejwe. Impinduka zica zikora.
webSearch.providerAutoDescription: Koresha amabwirizwa y’ugushira mu bikorwa — ubu biri hasi n’ugushakisha inkuru zose hamwe.
webSearch.providerNewsDescription: Ishikira ivyombo vyose bibiri rimwe, igahuza ivyasohotse, niyo kimwe kibuze nta kibazo bibaho. Ubwiza bwihuta, amamuko atandukanye, n’inkuru zishoboka.
webSearch.providerGoogleNewsDescription: Ikoresha izina ridatangazwa, ririhuta — gusa icogushakisha ni co gishikira Google (nta konti canke cookies) kandi ivyavuye birashika mu segonda 1. Inyuma yo kumenya: akenshi risoma umutwe w’inkuru n’utuganuke, ntirisoma inkuru zose; inyishu zishobora gusigara hejuru.
webSearch.providerGdeltDescription: Idatabazanya ry’ubushakashatsi bw’inkuru z’isi zifise iyimpisho yirimwo umwanditsi, bikorohereza kubaza ibindi bibazo bisoma inkuru yose. Kubandanya biragabanijwe cane — gushakisha gukurikirana gushobora kurindira amasegonda make.
webSearch.providerBingDescription: Isoma impapuro zose kugira rishike ku nsiguro irimwo vyinshi, rikanakorera kuri web rusangi, atari ku nkuru gusa. Yamara, gushakisha bifata hagati ya segonda 30–90 kandi umwimbu ushobora kutangana gushika ku gushakisha gukurikirana.
webSearch.sourcesDescription: Inkomoko zitandukanye z’ugushakisha zigumya nk’ivyegeranyo. Ibibazo vy’ubushakashatsi bishobora kubigwiza vyikora.
webSearch.freshnessDescription: Ivyavuye vuba bigeze hehe. Automatic yemerera ikibazo cose gutora (inkuru nshasha ishimisha iy’umusi uheze).
webSearch.providerCombined: Gusaka bihambaye hamwe n'ibitangazo vy'imbere (Bing + Google News)
webSearch.providerCombinedDescription: Ihurika Bing grounding na Google News: ibitangazo bivamwo mu masegonda make mugihe gusaka bihambaye kwa Bing bigikora, kandi ushobora guhitamwo kwishura ushingiye ku bitangazo aho gutegereza igisubizo kirimwo vyose. Bing irangiye, vyose biratunganirizwa hamwe.
webSearch.providerBingResponsesDescription: Ikorana na Bing web grounding, ariko ikora nk'isabikanya rimwe ry'iciyumviro aho kuba Foundry agent — rimwe na rimwe birihuta cane. Ni amahitamwo mashasha ariko arageragezwa mu kwigereranya na Bing grounding.

analyzeInformation.title: Sesengura Amakuru

buildPresentations.title: Kubaka Ibiganiro
buildPresentations.prompt: Urashobora kumfasha nte gukora ibiganiro? Nyereka ingero z'imiterere itandukanye y'ibiganiro, impanuro z'amashusho, n'ingene utunganya amakuru ku bantu batandukanye.

workWithCode.title: Gukora na Kode
workWithCode.prompt: Urashobora gufasha mu gukora kode canke porogaramu nto? Nyereka ingero - haba kwandika kode nshasha, gukosora ingorane, canke gusobanura ingene ikintu gikora intambwe ku yindi.

gpt_5_2_chat.name: GPT-5.2 Chat

llama_4_maverick.name: Llama 4 Maverick

claude_opus_4_5.name: Claude Opus 4.5
